# R&J Mills Remodeling

R&J Mills Remodeling is a home remodeling contractor serving Louisville, Kentucky and nearby communities.

## Services
- Bathroom remodeling: custom tile, frameless glass, standalone tubs, heated floors, accessible showers, tub-to-shower conversions, and reconfigurations.
- Kitchen remodeling: layout changes, soffit removal, appliance installation, backsplashes, countertops, and cabinets.
- Interior renovations: wall removal, basement finishing, painting, staining, flooring, and door installation.
- Exterior improvements: decks, covered porches, fencing, windows, roofing, gutters, and repairs.

## Service area
Louisville, St. Matthews, Crescent Hill, Jeffersontown, Fern Creek, the Highlands, and nearby Kentucky communities.
